extracted.name: Seven Layer Dinner
extracted.description: This seven-layer dinner casserole recipe includes potatoes, carrots, and onions, plus long-grain rice and peas baked with sausage in a tomato sauce.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Butter a large casserole dish.
Layer potatoes, carrots, and onions in the prepared casserole dish. Sprinkle uncooked rice over vegetables. Add peas (with liquid); arrange pork sausage on top.
Dilute 1 can tomato soup with 1 can water in a large measuring cup; pour over sausage. Season with salt and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven, covered, for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking 1 hour more.
